name: im-forwarder-desktop
description: im-forwarder 桌面端（Electron）：托盘常驻、配置校验、状态/日志/合规面板与移动伴生控制 API
author: 戴轶 (DaiYi) <1703205607@qq.com> (https://github.com/DaiYiqq)

scripts.build: npm run icon && npm run build:core
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --universal --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64 --publish never
